title: Second trip to England and the 1954 recordings with Vic Ash
summary: She recalls a tour with Ralph Sharon and recording 'Pipe in the Glen' and a Maxixe tune for Parlophone.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe

That's right. The next --
Yes, so they're 48's and this is when I went to London, right?
'48, yes, but these records are from '54 -- the next one.
Oh, this is the second time I went. Yeah.
Do you recall making any records inbetween that period?
I didn't make any records inbetween, but I did -- let me see what I did. I did a series of broadcasts for the BBC in '48 when I went over there.
